map.输入饲料中霉菌毒素含量，按GB 13078标准判定是否超标并给出风险等级: Enter mycotoxin content in feed; judge against GB 13078 whether it exceeds limits and give a risk level
map.📚 深度解析：饲料霉菌毒素检测判定: Deep dive: Feed mycotoxin test and judgment
map.对 AFB1/ZEA/DON/OTA 实测值对照限量判定。: Compare measured AFB1/ZEA/DON/OTA values against limits.
map.猪配合饲料限量 50 μg/kg：实测 80 → 超标 160%，禁用并退料。: Pig compound feed limit 50 µg/kg: measured 80 → 160% over, prohibit and return.
map.AFB1=50 → 等于限量 100%，临界，建议控制来源。: AFB1=50 → equal to limit 100%, marginal; control the source.
map.参照 GB 13078 饲料卫生标准按动物与毒素分档。: Per GB 13078 feed hygiene standard, tiered by animal and toxin.
map.仔猪/雏鸡等幼龄动物限量更严格，须单独判定。: Piglets/chicks and other young animals have stricter limits; judge separately.
map.检测依据GB 13078-2017《饲料卫生标准》，不同动物饲料毒素限值不同: Testing is based on GB 13078-2017 Feed Hygiene Standard; toxin limits differ by animal feed
map.仔猪/雏鸡饲料限值最严格，黄曲霉毒素B1≤10μg/kg: Piglet/chick feed has the strictest limits, aflatoxin B1 ≤10 µg/kg
map.黄曲霉毒素B1为强致癌物，超标饲料严禁饲喂，需脱毒或销毁: Aflatoxin B1 is a strong carcinogen; over-limit feed is strictly forbidden and must be detoxified or destroyed
map.玉米赤霉烯酮对母猪繁殖性能影响显著，超标可导致流产和不孕: Zearalenone strongly affects sow fertility; over-limit can cause abortion and infertility
map.建议每批次原料入库前检测，储存注意防潮防霉: Test each batch before storage; keep dry to prevent mold
map.饲料霉菌毒素检测判定工具，输入黄曲霉毒素B1、玉米赤霉烯酮、呕吐毒素、赭曲霉毒素: Feed mycotoxin test tool: enter aflatoxin B1, zearalenone, DON and ochratoxin A; judge against GB 13078 whether over limit and assess risk level.
map.四种主要霉菌毒素同步检测: Simultaneous test of four major mycotoxins
map.检测四项：黄曲霉毒素 B1、玉米赤霉烯酮、呕吐毒素 DON、赭曲霉毒素 A: Four mycotoxins tested: aflatoxin B1, zearalenone, deoxynivalenol DON, ochratoxin A
map.限量按饲料种类查表（μg/kg）：: Limits looked up by feed type (μg/kg):
map.猪配合料：AFB1 20｜ZEA 250｜DON 1000｜OTA 100: Pig compound feed: AFB1 20 | ZEA 250 | DON 1000 | OTA 100
map.单项判定：实测 ≤ 限值为合格，输出占限值百分比: Per-item verdict: measured ≤ limit means compliant, with the percentage of the limit output
map.风险评分累加：占比 >50% 且 ≤80% 加 1｜>80% 且 ≤100% 加: Risk score accumulation: share >50% and ≤80% adds 1 | >80% and ≤100% adds 2 | >100% adds 3
map.风险等级：超标 ≥2 项 高风险｜超标 ≥1 或评分 ≥3 中风险｜评分 ≥1: Risk level: ≥2 items over limit high risk | ≥1 item over limit or score ≥3 medium risk | score ≥1 low risk | otherwise safe
map.超标处置：AFB1 超标禁止饲喂需脱毒或销毁；ZEA 影响繁殖性能建议换原料: Corrective action: AFB1 over limit must not be fed and needs detoxification or destruction; ZEA affects reproductive performance, so switch raw material
map.DON 降低采食量可添加脱霉剂；OTA 损害肾脏须立即更换饲料: DON reduces feed intake and a mold binder may be added; OTA damages the kidneys, so the feed must be replaced immediately
map.危害说明：AFB1 强致癌伤肝｜ZEA 雌激素效应｜DON 影响免疫｜OTA 肾: Hazard notes: AFB1 strongly carcinogenic and liver-damaging | ZEA estrogenic effect | DON affects immunity | OTA nephrotoxic and carcinogenic
map.猪配合饲料限量 20 μg/kg：实测 80 为限量的 4 倍（超标 300%）: Pig compound feed limit 20 μg/kg: a measured 80 is 4 times the limit (300% over), so the batch is rejected and returned.
map.AFB1=20 → 等于限量 100%，临界，建议控制来源。: AFB1=20 → exactly 100% of the limit, borderline; controlling the source is advised.
